channel.title: epac Blog
channel.description: Civic explainers, app updates, and data spotlights from the epac team.

item.title: How to look up your MP's voting record
item.description: Every recorded vote in the House of Commons is public record. Here is how to find how your MP voted on any bill.

item.title: What is a federal riding?
item.description: Canada is divided into 338 federal electoral districts, each represented by one Member of Parliament. Here is how they work.

item.title: How to contact your MP during an election campaign
item.description: During a federal election, your MP is a candidate seeking re-election. Here is how to reach them and what to say.

item.title: What's in epac v1
item.description: A tour of what epac can do: Hansard debates, MP profiles, voting records, and more.

item.title: How epac tracks MP voting records
item.description: Every recorded vote is published by Parliament of Canada. Here is exactly how epac fetches and displays them.

item.title: What is Hansard?
item.description: The verbatim record of every word spoken in Canada's House of Commons — and why it matters.
